title: Scout suggestion run closes before caller validates or saves
answers: Why did the scout suggestions session close before saving results?
Why did the agent call finish before the caller finished validating?
How to fix background cloud agent runs terminating prematurely before caller validation?
body:
Symptom: Scout suggestions agent session closes prematurely before the caller can validate the output or save results.
Root cause: products/desktop/packages/harness/src/extensions/local-tools/tools/finish.ts:finishTool enabled the finish tool for scout_suggestions, allowing the agent to mark the run terminal prematurely.
Fix pattern: Exclude caller-managed task origins from the isEnabled predicate in the harness finish tool, preserving session closure for the caller.
Constraints: Applies to background cloud task runs where the caller controls session lifecycle across multiple turns; does not apply to standalone agent runs that must terminate themselves.
